Text: Sertraline is a prescription medicine used to treat depression, obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), panic disorders, posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), social anxiety disorder, and premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). It is sold under the brand name Zoloft, and generic sertraline is widely available.
Sertraline belongs to a group of medicines called selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or SSRIs. It increases serotonin activity in the brain by blocking the reuptake of serotonin (a chemical messenger that nerve cells use to communicate) back into nerve cells, so more of it stays available. Sertraline has only very weak effects on the reuptake of norepinephrine and dopamine, and it does not block monoamine oxidase.
Sertraline is available as tablets (25 mg, 50 mg, and 100 mg), oral solution (20 mg/mL), and capsules (150 mg and 200 mg).
Sertraline is not a controlled substance.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has inactive ingredient': The subject drug contains the inactive substance specified by the object entity.
C. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
D. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
